name: Yao Qinglan
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 level 5 or lower card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits from your hand as the bottom digivolution card of any of your Digimon with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of their traits, gain 1 memory.
